entries.description: Message console button auto. Add "auto" to /Buttons/List and click AUTO during a map message, or configure /Buttons/AutoKey with an existing MZ input symbol and press it. entries.title: voice-padding
entries.context: The configurable /Auto/VoiceActAutoPadding value is a count of game frames intended for a VoiceActControl provider. It is exposed in the settings for that external integration, but changing it alone has no effect on the local timer. This package supplies no voice command, association mechanism or positively qualified voice provider. There is no voice operation to invoke in this namespace. For ordinary auto-forward, configure /Auto/WaitPerChar and /Auto/MinimumWait and use the auto console button. External voice playback and its compatibility must be supplied by the external provider.
